description: OpenAPI breaking-change diff — Compare two versions of an API spec (OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0, JSON) and classify every change as breaking, warning, non-breaking or info: removed operations, new required parameters, optional-to-required, parameter or body type changes, removed request content types, removed 2xx responses, auth added, deprecations, server changes. Returns BREAKING / NON_BREAKING / IDENTICAL and a suggested semver bump (major/minor/patch). base= and head= are URLs (or raw JSON) of the old and new specs. Use it in CI to gate API releases. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_openapi_diff
